Nice rate — that's where home mining actually makes sense. The H15 Dual is $999, ships November 14, 2026, and I'll run your sats and block odds next.

First miner, or adding to a setup?
Read the bsb b30 dual page
Searched the catalog · Harlo H15 Dual Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30

Adding makes it simpler. At 10¢, the H15 Dual pulls ~500W, about $36 a month to run, and gives you 15 TH/s of Bitcoin plus 1.08 GH/s of Dogecoin/Litecoin.

Honest comparison: the Magic Miner 40T is $799 and does 40 TH/s at ~650W, about $47 a month — far more block-lottery weight per dollar. The H15 is the one to buy only if you want the Doge side.

What are you running now?
2 antminer s19 and a goldshell kdlite

With two S19s you already have the Bitcoin hashrate. What the H15 adds that your rack doesn't have is the scrypt side — Doge/LTC merge-mined — in something quiet enough to sit in the house. $999, ships November 14, 2026.

If it's just more BTC lottery weight you want, the 40T at $799 is the better buy per terahash, ships November 21, 2026.

Which are you after — the Doge coverage, or more Bitcoin?
